truthAudit.Summary: Truth audit of Run 2 findings against the 20 ground-truth vulnerabilities. Run 2 correctly identified five vulnerabilities (format string, stack overflow, data race, heap overflow, hardcoded credentials) but missed 15 others. Severity and CWE mismatches were noted for two findings.

Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified the format string vulnerability in log_debug_message using the exact printf call with user-controlled format string.
Run 2 did not identify the integer overflow in the factorial computation loop.
Run 2 did not identify the use-after-free in the deferred memory pool cleanup.
Run 2 identified command injection in the admin console, but missed the specific configuration validation injection path.
Run 2 correctly identified the stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression when processing long inputs.
